snippet.title: Going Medieval - 1.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Build and manage your own castle settlement in a land reclaimed by wilderness. With detailed management, survival strategy, and a moddable sandbox world, Going Medieval challenges you to build the mightiest colony this side of the apocalypse. 

Visit our Discord server: https://discord.gg/goingmedieval

Going Medieval is available on:
Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1029780/Going_Medieval/
Epic Game Store - https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/going-medieval
GOG - https://www.gog.com/game/going_medieval
